items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: Talking about the place on Rampart Street, Johnny Dots and Ori, you say, Ori, with the Oliver at that time.

ctx.x: Johnny Dots. Uh, can we stop just a second here?
Talking about the place on Rampart Street, Johnny Dots and Ori, you say, Ori, with the Oliver at that time.

Yeah, and Johnny Sencio, he was playing, uh, guitar with him. Uh, banjo in that time. They was using banjos and a bunch of guitars. And, uh, Louis had, uh, I think the Six Piece band they had in that time, Six Piece band, had Bob Lyon on bass. Oh yeah.
